yaya.deputy.label: Deputy agents
yaya.deputy.desc: Let the AI hand independent sub-tasks to deputies (sub-agents with tools) that work in parallel and report back; adds a Dispatch workflow
yaya.deputy.wf_desc: Split parallelizable requests into sub-tasks, run several deputies at once, then the main agent combines their reports; simple questions are answered directly
yaya.deputy.cfg.parallel_desc: Extra deputies wait for a free slot
yaya.deputy.cfg.rounds_desc: One round = one model call (may include several tool calls); when used up, tools are removed and the deputy writes its report
yaya.deputy.scope.readonly: Only tools that need no approval
yaya.deputy.err.no_workflow: Deputies only work inside a chat workflow
yaya.deputy.err.no_tasks: No runnable task: every item in tasks needs a task
